678-728-4939.description:
Cast Burning-Tree Emissary by paying its mana cost.
When Burning-Tree Emissary enters, it triggers, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Burning-Tree Emissary.
When Burning-Tree Emissary dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Burning-Tree Emissary from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it.
Repeat.

1170-3581-5131-6797--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {1}.
Kykar and Displacer Kitten trigger.
Resolve the Kykar trigger, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn
Activate Kykar by sacrificing the Spirit, adding {R}.
Repeat.

1032-3713-7839.description:

Smaug triggers, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters, Steelfin Whale triggers, untapping Steelfin Whale.
Repeat.

280-872-7857.description:
Activate Scaled Herbalist by tapping it, putting Golgari Rot Farm from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, it and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping Scaled Herbalist.
Repeat.

215-5295-6478.description:
Activate Arbor Adherent by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.

Cast Arbor Adherent by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

1363-1636-3652.easyPrerequisites:
You have enough mana to cast Ornithopter.
You control at least one additional creature,
1363-1636-3652.description:
Cast Ornithopter by paying its mana cost.
When Ornithopter enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Tradewind Rider by tapping it, Ornithopter and one other creature you control, returning Ornithopter from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
1363-1636-3652.notes: If you control creature(s) that can tap to produce mana, you can use that mana to pay for the creature and instead gain mana from the creature's ETB ability.

1624-5049-7439.description:
On the end step prior to your turn, cast a copy of Channel from exile by paying {G}{G}, unpreparing Yavimaya Bloomsage.
Use Channel's ability by paying 1 life, adding {C}.
Repeat step 2 until you have exactly 1 life.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Near-Death Experience triggers, causing you to win the game.

628-5231-7213.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Encumbered Reejerey.
When Encumbered Reejerey dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.

Activate Zhur-Taa Druid by tapping it, adding {U}.
Zhur-Taa Druid triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Zhur-Taa Druid.
Repeat.

3713-5078-5268-6650.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

4681-5170-5686-6094.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger.
Resolve the Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

1115-2366-4974-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
1115-2366-4974-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Zendikar Resurgent triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

147-2438-6814.description:
Cast Abnormal Endurance by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Abnormal Endurance, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Abnormal Endurance.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Carrion Feeder abilities from step 5.

4658-5306-5755.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is higher than or equal to an opponent's.
4658-5306-5755.description:
Activate Disciple of Griselbrand by paying {1} and sacrificing Soul of Eternity, causing you to gain life equal to Soul of Eternity's toughness.
Enduring Tenacity triggers, causing target opponent to lose life equal to the life you gained.

280-1399-1606-1680.description:
Activate Golgari Rot Farm by tapping it, adding {B}{G}
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Golgari Rot Farm.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat.

2500-2719-3609--121.easyPrerequisites: Creatures you control have power 3 or greater.
2500-2719-3609--121.description:
Activate Mirage Mirror by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of the Spacecraft until end of turn
Activate Mirage Mirror by tapping a creature with power 3 or greater, putting at least three charge counters on it.
During your next turn, activate Mirage Mirror twice by paying {4}, with the first ability targeting the Spacecraft and the second ability targeting Magistrate's Scepter.
Resolve the first ability, causing Mirage Mirror to become a copy of Magistrate's Scepter until end of turn.
Holding priority, activate Mirage Mirror's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the second Mirage Mirror ability from step 3, causing it to become a copy of the Spacecraft until end of turn.
Repeat from step 2.
2500-2719-3609--121.notes: If the creature(s) tapped has power 4 or greater, you may be able to bypass causing Mirage Mirror to become a copy of the Spacecraft. This can be done as long as Mirage Mirror has six or more charge counters on it before starting step 3.

997-6014-6659.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another modified creature.
When the creature dies, Guardian of the Forgotten triggers, manifesting the top card of your library.
When the manifested card enters the battlefield, Gylwain triggers, creating a Role token attached to the manifested creature.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

2438-2730-6553.easyPrerequisites: Kaya's Ghostform attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
2438-2730-6553.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

3384-4067-5042-6480.description:
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, tapping Rescue Leopard.
Rescue Leopard triggers, causing you to discard a card and draw four cards.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Rescue Leopard.
Repeat.

4050-5632-5751-5763.description:
Cast Circle of the Land Druid from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {1}{G} and discarding a land card.
Chalk Outline triggers, creating a creature token.
When Circle of the Land Druid enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the creature token and Circle of the Land Druid, adding {1}{G}.
When Circle of the Land Druid dies, its second ability triggers, returning a land card from your graveyard to your hand.
Chalk Outline triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

38-2376-2420.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing Scuzzback Marauders, adding {R}.
When Scuzzback Marauders dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Rhythm of the Wild.
Repeat.

1247-4188-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Accomplished Alchemist's ability by tapping it, adding at least two mana of any color.
Activate Marvin using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

Zimone and Dina does not have summoning sickness.

224-1525-3678-4913.description:
Activate Zimone and Dina by tapping it and sacrificing another creature, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card, put it into your hand, then put the land onto the battlefield tapped, and repeat this process once if you control at least eight lands.
Retreat to Coralhelm and Retreat to Emeria trigger for each land that enters the battlefield this way.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger(s), untapping Zimone and Dina.
Resolve the Retreat to Emeria trigger(s), creating that many creature tokens.
Repeat.

Your life total is equal to or greater than half the highest life total among your opponents, rounded up.

140-805-3591.description:
Activate Necropotence by paying 1 life, exiling the top card of your library.
Repeat step 1 until you have paid an amount of life equal to half the highest life total among your opponents, rounded up.
Activate Rowan by tapping it, reducing the cost of all black and/or red spells you cast this turn.
Cast Debt to the Deathless, choosing for X to equal the amount of life you've lost this turn, but paying a total of {W}{W}{B}{B} due to Rowan's ability.
Resolve Debt to the Deathless, causing each opponent to lose twice X life, and you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.
Each opponent loses the game due to having 0 or less life.

369-1258-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Iridescent Drake.
When Iridescent Drake dies, Abduction triggers, returning Iridescent Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Iridescent Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Abduction from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Iridescent Drake.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1, causing target player to mill cards equal to Iridescent Drake's power.
Repeat.

1769-2201-2641-4816.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two opponents.
1769-2201-2641-4816.description:
Cast Rot Hulk by paying {5}{B}{B}.
Rot Hulk dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Rot Hulk's enter the battlefield trigger is put onto the stack.
Resolve the Rot Hulk trigger, returning Rot Hulk and Infectious Host from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Rot Hulk and Infectious Host die as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
The Infectious Host and Rot Hulk triggers are put on the stack.
Resolve the Infectious Host trigger, causing target player to lose 2 life.
Repeat from step 4.

Sword of the Paruns attached to Kiki-Jiki.
At least nine creatures in your graveyard.

The token enters gaining you 9 life.
